content: {"praised":["Lives up to high expectations and delivers intense horror.","Sets new benchmark for French horror cinema.","Dark, atmospheric tone with powerful visuals.","Strong thematic depth beyond gore.","Engaging, twisty narrative structure."],"criticized":["Excessive torture and gore, considered torture porn.","Thin plot with little character development.","Overly graphic violence, especially of women.","Confusing title and premise.","Lack of meaningful story beyond shock."]}
